scope: scripts/test_vci_host_mcp.py on the frozen Debug Host of 133a513 (artifacts/vgd) with absent native workers (80 recorded checks), adding vci_push and vci_fetch against a run-owned local bare remote given as --git-remote: a first push creating the branch, a compare-and-swap refusal, a parentless fetch reproducing the exact bytes, an unchanged fetch refused, a compare-and-swap fast-forward push, and a fetch from a fetched parent after a Host restart, with every output validated against contracts/vci-workspace.v1.
limitations: Host-only: native engineering and simulator workers are deliberately absent; no TIA Portal, Openness, PLCSIM or device is involved and none is qualified.
Local bare remote only; network remotes, credentials and remote-side hooks beyond the refusal checks are not exercised.
Synthetic fixtures on PCNico only; no other Host build or scale beyond the runner's bounds is qualified.
